title: Marcos turns over 333 homes to flood-hit Valenzuela City families

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. on Tuesday led the ceremonial turnover of 333 housing units at Disiplina Village in Arkong Bato, Valenzuela City, for residents relocated from flood-prone areas. The Disiplina Village Arkong Bato project was designed to provide 960 housing units for qualified informal settler families affected by the Supreme Court’s mandamus to clear Manila Bay, as well as those residing in danger zones in Valenzuela City. READ: LIST: Big names, others arrested in flood control scandal Nine buildings have been completed under Phases 1, 2, and 3, comprising 333 units. The relocation of beneficiaries began in April.
